Welcome to The World's Game.

Experience football like never before in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds, a dynamic social football playground where the streets meet the stadium. Whether you're playing Kickabouts, competing in 1v1 matches or teaming up with friends in Clubs, connect with legendary football mentors, sharpen your skills and express your style both on and off the pitch.

Build your dream squad in Football Ultimate Team™ and celebrate your greatest achievements with the all-new FUT Gallery. Collect your favourite Player Items, increase your Gallery Level, unlock rewards and shape your Club's identity throughout the football season.

The Heroic Games are about to begin! Enter the Dagdan Empire—a prosperous land ruled by the gods—and compete in the Heroic Games for the chance to be granted one wish. Powerful fighters from across the land have gathered to participate, including four heroes whose fortunes are tied to the fate of the world. Play as Cai, a young boy determined to win the games to save his imprisoned father; Dietrich, a swordsman ever on the hunt for a stronger foe; Theodora, a queen seeking to fulfill the long-held dream of her homeland; and Leda, a musician with her sights set on revenge. The stories of these four heroes are key to this time-traveling saga of strength and steel. Guide your heroes to victory as each weaves their own tale Prepare for each match of the Heroic Games by exploring Dagda and its capital city of Dagsion. How you spend your free time is up to you, but the tactical matches of the Games themselves will put your preparations to the test. entry.summary:
Vendor: Nintendo
Type: Video Game Software

Hunt for treasure in a wild adventure!

In this single-player-focused game, play as a mechanic working with Deep Cut—a trio of swashbuckling musicians—and venture out into the mysterious Spirhalite Islands!

Head out on raids

Pick a destination and see what goodies you can find. Fight Salmonids, gather salvage, and uncover the mysteries of the islands.

Score treasure

Scoop up purdy Spirhalite Crystals and other salvage that you find out there—you never know what might come in handy! Some stages may also contain rare relics that can power you up. You’ll keep everything you pick up on solo raids, no matter what happens.

Tinker with your gear

Not gonna lie: Salmonids can put up a fight. Use the salvage you recover during raids to craft all sorts of enhancements back at your Hideout Ship. Whether you’re upgrading gear, leveling up weapons, or enhancing home base, every little bit helps!

Roll out with your bot buddy

One member of Deep Cut will raid alongside you in a powerful bot construct. Aside from helping in battle, you can jump off them to soar to new heights or build up powerful Showstopper attacks. Wield them wisely to unleash absolute heck!

Play your way

Find your sweet spot with Tourist, Raider, and Survivalist difficulty levels. Change it anytime! Just know that this only affects combat, not the loot you can get.

Gear up with amiibo

Tap in a Splatoon series amiibo figure (like these) to unlock stylish fits for the Mechanic.

Vendor: Capcom
Type: Video Game Software

Capcom’s newest IP, PRAGMATA, is an all-new sci-fi action-adventure game with unique hacking gameplay. Set on the moon in the near future, the story follows an unlikely duo on a mission to escape a lunar station controlled by a hostile station AI. In this single-player game, players control both spacefarer Hugh and the enigmatic android Diana. Each character has their own distinct skills and abilities, and they must work together to hack, shoot, and overcome obstacles in search of a way back to Earth.

Features & details

  • Out-of-This-World Adventure – Stranded on a lunar space station, Hugh encounters Diana, a mysterious android resembling a young girl. While searching for a way back to Earth, they fight to survive against Bots directed to “neutralize” intruders.
  • Hack & Shoot – Use each character’s distinct abilities to take down enemies. In combat, Diana can hack foes to expose weaknesses so Hugh can blast them with weapons. This unique fusion of gameplay offers an action-packed experience like no other.
  • Space Exploration – Teamwork also extends to traversing the station. Utilize the thrusters in Hugh’s futuristic suit to dash and hover around while Diana hacks security systems to solve puzzles. Only together can they overcome all obstacles.
  • Collect and Customize – Gather materials while exploring the station to unlock upgrades, build out a diverse arsenal of weapons, obtain new outfits, and more. Once you’re ready, use the new gear in battle and take on even greater challenges!

Monster Hunter Stories 3: Twisted Reflection is the newest entry in the Monster Hunter Stories RPG series.

Two nations, Azuria and Vermeil, are on the brink of ruin as a crystal encroachment spreads across the land. A mysterious egg hatches two Skyscale Rathalos, legendary monsters tied to a prophecy of destruction from a war that took place 200 years ago.
